quests.title: Floral Pursuit

dialogue.t: *sigh* Can the Guild really manage this amount of work...
Ah, Traveler! My apologies for not noticing you sooner. I had some Guild affairs on my mind...
You must be here in Mondstadt for the Windblume Festival, I presume?
You're just in time: The Guild has just come up with a little game — a guaranteed romp with prizes to be won!
How about it? Wanna give it a go?
Let me introduce this little game to you first. The person who designed it calls it "Floral Chess."
He said that his inspiration came from the billowing petals and the wind that pursues them...
And the game is meant to imitate the... romanticism of pursuing these flower petals...
Well, this inventor is a bard, so he has more of... You know, an imagination.
Basically, when you're playing this form of chess, you need to collect as many Bloom Balloons within the chessboard as possible.
You'll have to avoid various obstacles in the process... and there'll be some tools on hand to lend you some support...
That fellow even wrote an entire manual for this game, which I'll let you have a look at later.
If you're interested, you're welcome to play. Remember, prizes are guaranteed just for participating!

quests.description: Plauen of the Adventurers’ Guild seems to be busy with something…
